top_signal.title: At What Point does the Script Flip from "I have a Business" to "The Business has Me?"
top_signal.summary: And where does that line fall? Because as I sit here writing this just two days after I shut the doors on a business that I built over ten years to over thirty employees, I reflect as to what made me do it and how did it all happen?    For many years I was telling myself that I was building freedom, I was building a business, I was building security for thirty plus people, so that I could take on bigger and better clients and create more of that security and more of that freedom.    Started that ten years ago. It started from a two person operation, just running it out of a room in the house, which eventually made us outgrow that, and we took on some people to help us with customers. And as we grew, we got more people in, and as the economy was booming. My business grew to very high revenues that I could not even imagine, but at some point it led me to meet my limit, and that limit didn't come all of the sudden. It seemed like I could maintain, and it was a very high limit of working during the day with my people to make sure everything is running in the day to day operations properly. Then I would go. And pick up my kid from school, dropped off at home, and then we would have a small family gathering, have a dinner, I would have a nap, wake up around half an hour later, and then I handled another time zone.
